description: Shield public funds from the agent wallet into the private pool. Signs and pays gas from the agent wallet. Takes 30-90 s. Do not retry after a timeout without checking blackpool_balance.

amount.description: Decimal amount in token units, e.g. "10" or "0.25", or "max" (send: the whole pool balance; swap/bridge: the most one operation can move). Never wei.

pool.description: Pool on that chain: eth|usdc (base, arbitrum), eth|usdg (robinhood), bnb|usdc|usdt (bsc). Default: the chain's stablecoin pool.

name: blackpool_deposit
title: Shield (deposit)
